body.en: A folding reading light for the last occupied desk.
body.zh: 桌上摊开一本书，灯头能压到多低？

notes.en: Introduce the fictional design study and its intended reading scene.
notes.zh: 把观众的目光引到灯头和书页之间

title.en:
Put the light
on the page.

body.en: A thin blade pivots over the book. The round base keeps the rest of the desk free for a notebook and a cup.
body.zh: 转轴往下一折，光落到书页上，圆底座旁边还能搁下杯子

notes.en: Follow the line from the base, through the pivot, to the edge of the blade.
notes.zh: 指出灯头的转轴和底座的边缘

body.en: The first prototype will test reach, warmth and stability at the desk.
body.zh: 开灯看光能铺多宽，再试试灯头压低时底座稳不稳

notes.en: These are design targets. Distinguish them from measured performance.
notes.zh: 这些数值是打样目标，实测记录等样机回来再填

body.en: Review the {{light}} target with a lighting partner before freezing the first prototype.
body.zh: 请照明合作方确认 {{light}} 这个目标，下一轮就按这个色温做样机

notes.en: Ask the partner which reading environment to use for the first test.
notes.zh: 跟合作方约好试灯的桌面和环境光
